newsitem.title: UK: Goons founder Michael Bentine dies at 74.
newsitem.headline: Goons founder Michael Bentine dies at 74.

text.p: Michael Bentine, a founder member of the anarchic Goons team that transformed British comedy, has died of prostate cancer at the age of 74.
The Peruvian comic, who had already seen both his parents and two of his daughters succumb to cancer, died in a London hospital on Tuesday evening, officials said.

Bentine, whose grandfather was elected President of Peru, was brought up in England and conquered a chronic stammer to become a rocket physicist, Shakespearean actor, journalist and author of 14 books.
But he achieved lasting fame as founder of the Goons radio show with Peter Sellers, Spike Milligan and Harry Secombe.
Modern-day comics such as the Monty Python Circus team say that the zany Goons with their crazy non-sequiturs and surreal characters were a major influence on their technique.
Prince Charles, heir to the British throne, is also a great fan of the Goons.
